description: Agent Accountability: submit an MCP or tool-access architecture: the gateway with the checks it runs, what decides allow or deny and what happens when it is down, and every tool with its effect, whether it is reached through the gateway, who reaches it directly and where its calls are traced. The signed report names every tool path that skips the gateway’s deterministic checks, every tool reachable both through the gateway and directly, and whether tracing covers the unmediated paths. Check order inside one payment flow is wever_firewall-order-check. Verdict unmediated_paths, coverage_unverified or fully_mediated. POST /api/gateway-coverage-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-accountability-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-accountability/.
